sys_app.name: ClientScript Medic
sys_app.short_description: Audits client-side scripts and UI policies for field-level conflicts, broken references, and overlapping policies.

sys_user_role.description: ClientScript Medic administrator — full access to run scans, view findings, and manage configuration.
sys_user_role.name: x_snc_csm.admin

sys_user_role.description: ClientScript Medic user — read-only access to findings, conflict maps, and health scores.
sys_user_role.name: x_snc_csm.user

sys_script_include.description: Deterministic audit engine: conflict map, overlap detection, reference resolution, health scoring.
sys_script_include.name: ClientScriptMedicEngine

sys_script_include.description: Advisory AI layer: generates remediation suggestions via Generative AI Controller, degrades to rule-based templates.
sys_script_include.name: ClientScriptMedicAI

sys_script_include.description: Nightly delta audit: diffs new scan against previous baseline, emits new/resolved/regressed digest.
sys_script_include.name: ClientScriptMedicDeltaAudit

sys_ws_definition.name: ClientScript Medic API
sys_ws_definition.short_description: REST API for ClientScript Medic: run scans, query conflicts, health scores, and findings.

sys_ws_operation.name: Execute
Status

sysauto_script.description: Nightly delta audit: re-runs the full client-script/UI-policy scan and diffs against the previous baseline, emitting a new/resolved/regressed digest.
sysauto_script.name: ClientScript Medic Nightly Delta Audit
